description: This file defines an interface class 'IResourceProvider' within the 'CalculationManager' namespace. The interface provides a method to retrieve localized or resource strings used by a calculation engine, including specific string IDs like 'sDecimal', 'sThousand', and 'sGrouping'.

classes.name: CalculationManager::IResourceProvider
classes.description: An interface class that provides a method to retrieve resource strings for the calculation engine.

methods.name: GetCEngineString
